aiVerification.summary: Draft detects a comparable STD vs Mark 3db acoustic test but misstates the changed factor and contains invalid outcome grouping.
issues: Changed factor is taken from filename instead of STD vs Mark 3db rows.
Baseline and changed conditions are incorrectly marked not explicit.
Outcomes mix specs, raw samples, zeros, and formula errors as metrics.
Many subResults use numeric values or #DIV/0 as conditions.
Review title and change domain are not evidence-based.
requiredUserQuestions: What physical change does Mark 3db represent, if it must be named beyond the label?
correctionPlan: Set primary comparison to STD baseline versus Mark 3db test.
Use GRAPH rows 2-9 and RAW DATA rows 2-6 as core citations.
Group outcomes by SPL bands, Fo, and THD metrics only.
Remove zero-filled, #DIV/0, and misparsed raw-data statistics.
Compare STD and Mark 3db averages with spec limits separately.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient because many cited rows do not support the drafted grouping or stats.
